name: Delicate Instruments

angles.text: The delicate arcane apparatus in the Tower of Azora requires extreme environmental stability, demonstrating how crude geomantic interference can disrupt disciplined arcane studies.
Assisting the researchers at the Tower of Azora helps safeguard Elwynn Forest's scholarly enclaves from the chaotic meddling of subterranean pests.

faq.answer: Hamish Bergwort is an arcane researcher stationed at the Tower of Azora in Elwynn Forest. He works with sensitive instruments that require precise calibration, which are prone to disruption from ambient magical fluctuations.
The instruments are being disrupted by surges of magical energy radiating from Jasperlode Mine to the north, generated by primitive kobolds practicing crude earth magic.
faq.q: Why are the arcane instruments malfunctioning?

faq.answer: Jasperlode Mine is an infested mine north of the Tower of Azora in Elwynn Forest. Kobolds have overrun the tunnels, where their spellcasters conduct chaotic geomantic rituals that ripple across the surrounding woods.

Kobold geomancers are subterranean spellcasters among the kobold packs who wield crude, elemental earth magic. Though primitive, their collective channeling creates notable magical disturbances that interfere with sensitive arcane equipment.

Culling the geomancers inside Jasperlode Mine halts the continuous elemental energy spikes, allowing researchers at the Tower of Azora to properly calibrate their sensitive arcane devices without interference.
faq.q: How does eliminating the geomancers resolve the issue?

faq.answer: The Tower of Azora is a prominent spire of arcane study located in eastern Elwynn Forest. Scholars and mages there observe regional phenomena and maintain finely tuned magical apparatus.
faq.q: What is the Tower of Azora?

sections.body: Inside the Tower of Azora, Hamish Bergwort oversees delicate arcane apparatus that requires fine calibration. Unfortunately for the scholar, the surrounding countryside is far from quiet. Repeated surges of uncontrolled energy constantly throw off his measurements, rendering careful magical adjustments impossible until the source of the interference is addressed.
sections.title: Disrupted Calibrations

sections.body: Investigation traces the magical pulses directly northward to Jasperlode Mine. The subterranean tunnels have been claimed by kobolds, whose geomancers channel crude earth magic within the stone. While their sorcery lacks scholarly refinement, the sheer frequency of their crude rituals generates elemental ripples potent enough to travel through the earth and unsettle Azora's sensitive instruments.
sections.title: The Interference from Jasperlode

summary: Delicate Instruments is a quest in Elwynn Forest given by Hamish Bergwort at the Tower of Azora. Hamish's sensitive arcane equipment is being disrupted by erratic magical surges radiating from the north. To restore stability, travelers must enter Jasperlode Mine and cull the kobold geomancers responsible for the disturbances.
